title: Visual world · new hand
question: Everything from the first round is eliminated. This hand approaches Nick through different working rituals and visual traditions.

options.label: The Patch Set
options.lineage: code review · annotated diffs · changes that earn trust
options.thesis: Nick’s authority appears as a legible patch: what changed, why it matters, and the evidence that makes it safe to ship.
options.viewport: A large plain-language AI-native DX thesis sits beside Nick’s portrait; precise change marks connect current role, shipped systems, teaching, and the Workshops action without resembling a code editor.
options.risk: Could become terminal cosplay or a novelty diff if plus/minus symbols replace real hierarchy; the system must feel editorial and human.

options.label: Claim / Proof
options.lineage: monochrome product publishing · interface evidence · rigorous restraint
options.thesis: Every claim about Nick is immediately followed by the work that proves it.
options.case: Strongest pure product clarity, but the most conventional and least personally identifiable direction in this hand.
options.viewport: A restrained portrait and thesis lead directly into a workshop action; each following statement pairs with a talk, article, system, or workshop image.
options.risk: Its discipline can become tasteful generic software marketing unless Nick’s voice and evidence dominate every section.

options.label: Sixteen Steps
options.lineage: rhythm-machine sequences · iterative engineering · live teaching
options.thesis: The site has a pulse: build, inspect, teach, and compound repeat as one visible sequence.
options.case: Most memorable interaction and a natural workshop arc, but it identifies an instrument before it identifies Nick unless used with restraint.
options.viewport: Nick’s portrait and thesis sit above one unbroken semantic sequence; the active step lands on Workshops while writing, speaking, and systems remain readable stages.
options.risk: Can become a playful sequencer demo that distracts technical leaders; reduced motion must preserve a calm, useful document.

options.label: The Stage Cue
options.lineage: conference lighting plots · cue states · the room before a live session
options.thesis: Nick’s work moves from preparation to live practice to the moment a room starts shipping differently.
options.case: Connects speaking and workshop leadership with a strong light/dark system; weaker for the writing archive than the assigned direction.
options.viewport: A portrait emerges across a crisp dark-to-light horizon while the thesis, verified role, and Workshops cue remain fully semantic and immediately readable.
options.risk: Color bands can become a decorative gradient and over-romanticize speaking; the cue structure must carry real content and accessible named states.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished technical personal site with a portrait hero, selected work, and a clear workshops button.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar navigation, portrait and thesis side by side, primary workshop action, then selected writing and talks.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand and easy to forget; choose this only if familiarity matters more than a distinctive authored world.
